Title: Announcing the Azure API Management roadmap

Body.Content: In response to popular demand, we are pleased to announce the Azure API Management roadmap. We hope it will help you, our customers and partners, stay abreast of our plans, follow our progress, and provide input. Read the full announcement on our blog.
